messages.subject: novice question too
parts:
Dear DISTANCE listserver
We are conducting a series of surveys of Weddell seals hauled out on the
Antarctic fastice. We want to show seasonal changes in their abundance. My
question is whether to repeatedly survey the same set of randomly-placed
transects, or whether we should take a new set of randomly-placed transects
at each time interval.

I apologize if I have missed this in the literature.

Yours sincerely
Sam Lake
